title: Scattering off Chamblin-Reall Branes
summary: We study the linearized scattering of dilaton-graviton waves from a thin brane in three-dimensional spacetime. Holographically, the setup models scattering from an interface in a family of strongly coupled theories related to dimensional reductions of higher-dimensional $AdS_{d+2}$ gravity. Unlike the pure $AdS_3$ case, for $d>1$ the physical bulk mode allows incident radiation to be redistributed into reflected, transmitted, and evanescent components.
